competences.description: Attacks the enemy to stun for 1 turn with a 30% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 2 to 3 times to deal damage proportionate to your Defense. Each hit steals 1 beneficial effect and decreases Attack Bar by 15% with a 20% chance each.

effets.description: Remove a beneficial effect and take it for yourself

competences.description: Removes all harmful effects on all allies and attacks all enemies to deal damage proportionate to your Defense. The damage increases up to 200% by the number of harmful effects removed. In addition, increases your Attack Bar by 10% each, up to 100%, when an ally is granted a harmful effect while the skill is on cooldown.

effets.note: up to 200% by the number of harmful effects removed

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: up to 100%, when an ally receives a harmful effect while the skill is on cooldown
